name: Stormbringer: Cyclone's Embrace and Spellstorm Mastery work natively (#1821, #2782)
contract: #1821: Cyclone's Embrace (301318) effect 0 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = 100%, EffectSpellClassMask[2] = 1048576 (dword 2, bit 20), which resolves to exactly the Kiss of the Clouds rank chain (355241, 500039 Rank 1, 501442-501449 Rank 2..9) and nothing else, both SpellFamilyName 22. Kiss of the Clouds 500039's AttributesEx3 = 256 (ONLY_ON_PLAYER, not IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS), so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod (SpellInfo.cpp:1472) -> IsAffected (SpellInfo.cpp:1437) passes, and Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12157) inside SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:519) applies the SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 multiplier before EffectTriggerSpellWithValue (SpellEffects.cpp:1237-1243) hands the amount to 500292's SCHOOL_ABSORB. At level 80 (clamped to MaxLevel 24, reduced by max(BaseLevel,SpellLevel)=17): EffectBasePoints 100 + int32(7 x 1.95429 = 13.68) = 113, +1 die roll = 114 baseline, doubling to 228 with the talent (totalmul = 1 + 100/100 = 2, Player.cpp:10272-10275/10325). #2782: Spellstorm Mastery (705659 rank 1, 705660 rank 2) effect 0 is the same aura 108 family, EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), EffectBasePoints 14/29 + 1 = 15%/30%, EffectSpellClassMask[0] = 8 (dword 0, bit 3), which resolves to exactly the Aegis set: 680282 Whirlwind Aegis Rank 1 .. 680594 Rank 6, 680316 Shocking Aegis, 680334 Tempest Aegis, all granted to class 16 by the module (AscensionCustomClassData.h {16,4,680282}, {16,26,680316}, {16,44,680334}). SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS is applied to every effect of an affected spell generically (Unit.cpp:12153); no Aegis spell carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS. Whirlwind Aegis rank 6 (680594, the level-80 rank) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE with EffectBasePoints 559 + 1 = 560 armor, so +15%/+30% gives 644/728. Effect 1 (spell haste, base 2+1=3) is deliberately not asserted: 3 x 1.15 = 3.45 truncates back to 3 at SpellInfo.cpp:581 (int32 CalcValue), which would look like a false negative on a mechanism that is actually working. The two Spellstorm Mastery ranks have no spell_ranks row in data/sql/, so rank 1 is unlearned before rank 2 is learned to avoid stacking to +45%. Neither 301318 nor 705659/705660 has any occurrence in modules/ or src/server/; both close as regression scenarios only.
